images.prompt: ONE landscape 1536x1024 editorial photograph using exact attached navy Himawari No.1211 backpack, external26cm width40cm height17cm depth. Preserve reference geometry, logo, every attachment; all compartments closed. On a low walnut bench in a quiet hallway, front facing with slight elevated camera to clearly see where two zipper sliders meet on front pocket. Adult man's hand resting beside bag on bench, NOT opening/touching zipper. Bag occupies60percent frame height, full bag. Warm daylight, natural precise detail, no props or text overlays, not a security/lock demonstration.
